nodes.original_target: The transition from the finite presented carrier (integer weights, finite report labels) to a continuous infinite-dimensional Hilbert space is not constructed in any source; QM_122 s6 refuses it. M_n(Z[i]) is recovered for finite report sets but is not M_n(C): Z[i] is not a field and a self-adjoint Gaussian-integer matrix need not have a Gaussian-integer eigenvalue (GAP-F001-S000-009).
The whole-program QM rewrite is not complete; the consolidation narrows its scope without discharging it.

Receipt and custody items: 48 (ledger) vs 24 (GAP-FQM-002 text) untyped claim rows; GAP-FQM-017 QM_208-211 claim maps point at nonexistent *_lib libraries (tautology tests); GAP-FQM-019 eight claims need a Mathlib build to promote; GAP-FQM-020 QM_122 axiom report covers 22 of 53 files and hides a Classical.choice dependency (H019.basisGen8_eval_pos); GAP-FQM-022 QM_122 provenance cites nonexistent sources; QM_020 and QM_080 are published (Zenodo) and not free to rewrite; README states the code-companion --check fails on the current tree.

Hilbert tensor product as the unique way to combine systems remains extra structure; rival exclusions exist only for stated hosts and covariance requirements. Bipartite composition and entangled preparation are load-bearing for Bell (s13.8.2).

The circle group U(1) is not constructed on the finite host; continuity of a one-parameter phase group remains a hypothesis. In Q(i), u=(3+4i)/5 has no square root and n -> u^n is injective, so no homomorphism (Q,+) -> U(1)(Q(i)) sends 1 to u.

On rational 2-vectors there is a binary-valued, scale-invariant frame function (additive on orthogonal frames) with no quadratic representation (no_quadratic_representation); in dimension 2 the Gleason dimension condition fails.

Hadamard-style mixing separates points of one phase-blind fiber: no function f satisfies readout = f o phaseBlind once mixing is applied (no_descent_through_fiber, mix_separates). Phase information is observable only after a non-diagonal operation.

A matrix A descends through the phase-blind population report iff every row has at most one nonzero entry, provided the quotient retains the zero vector as a distinct output; without the retained zero point the claim is false on projective space (A = [[1,1],[1,1]]).

On Z[i]-valued report vectors the phase-blind weight |c_q|^2 is nonnegative and real; a global phase and (in the Lean example) a relative phase lie inside one phase-blind fiber; two vectors are zero-related under the phase-blind difference iff phasePD_zeroRel_iff. Fiber enumeration uses a declared finite unit group.
Positive normalized L1 weights on preparations are additional carrier data; a bare distinction relation does not supply them. Every finite Bell/CHSH statement below takes them as given.
